description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Sisilasagama and Chithragala, Hambantota D/S Division, Hambantota District (25/0350)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, their ownership details, and registration particulars. The content is focused entirely on land and property matters, including title determinations for both private individuals and state-owned lands, making it clearly fall under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
